name: Acid Vial
description: Either splash the contents on a creature within 5ft, or hurl the container up to 20ft, smashing on impact. Both are ranged attacks.

name: Healing Potion
description: Drink this potion to regain 2d4 + 2 hit points. It has no effect on undead or constructs.

name: Iron-Banded Club
description: A sturdy club reinforced with iron bands, said to have been blessed by a local priest to ward off creatures of the night. Adds +1 damage to attacks.

name: Minstrel's Silver Ring
description: A simple silver band once worn by a traveling minstrel. Adds +5% to Charm tests.

name: Studded Leather Armor
description: A well-crafted leather garment, providing 1 AP (body only).

name: Iron-Toe Boots
description: Sturdy boots reinforced with iron toes, rumored to have been worn by a miner who braved collapsing tunnels. Gives +10% to resist falling or tripping.

name: Traveler’s Hooded Cloak
description: A durable, weatherproof cloak, stitched with the symbol of a long-lost trade guild. Provides +5% to stealth.

name: Runed Hunting Knife
description: A short blade, engraved with runes by a hedge wizard who claimed it would repel forest predators. Adds +5% to weapon skill and deals +1 damage against beasts.

name: Enchanted Elven Cloak
description: A finely woven cloak that always remains dry. +10% bonus to Stealth tests.

name: Warding Amulet
description: A carved charm passed down through generations, reputed to keep malevolent spirits at bay. Provides a +10% bonus on Willpower tests against being controlled.

name: Dwarven Steel Gauntlets
description: Gauntlets forged by a wandering dwarven blacksmith. Adds +1 AP to arms and +10% to Grip-based tests.

name: Ashwood Longbow
description: A bow crafted from the trees of the Great Forest, rumored to have been made under elven guidance. Adds +1 damage and +5% to Ballistic Skill tests.

name: Elven Moonblade
description: A glowing sword that emits moonlight (10ft radius). Deals +1 damage and grants +10% attack bonus under moonlight.

name: Diadem of the Sun
description: A radiant headpiece, rumored to have been blessed by the priests of Myrmidia. Adds +10% to Fellowship tests and glows faintly in darkness.

name: Dragon-Bone Composite Bow
description: A bow made from the bones of a slain dragon, said to pierce even the thickest armor. Adds +2 armor piercing and doubles effective range.

name: Runeforged Plate Armor
description: Armor engraved with magical runes by a long-dead master smith. Provides 3 AP (all locations) and reduces incoming magic damage by 1.

name: Obsidian Necklace
description: A necklace reportedly crafted in Naggaroth by Dark Elf assassins. Grants +10% to Stealth tests and allows a reroll once per day.

name: Dreadfang
description: A wyrm-fang dagger that deals +1 damage, ignores 1 point of armor, and deals +2 damage to reptilian/dragon creatures. Rolling doubles triggers hesitation (-10% WS for 1 round).

stats.effect: +1 DMG, ignores 1 armor, +2 DMG vs reptiles

name: Stormveil Cloak
description: A storm-powered cloak granting +10% movement, +5% Dodge, and resistance to weather hazards/magic. Stress chills impose a -5% Willpower penalty during combat.

name: Shard of Celestia
description: A pendant granting one reroll on any failed test once per day. Using it causes distracting visions, imposing -5% on Intelligence-based tests for 30 minutes.

name: Blade of the Mountain King
description: A runesilver greatsword dealing +2 damage (+4 vs Chaos) and ignoring magical barriers. Its hum of power reduces Stealth by -5% when drawn.

stats.effect: +2 DMG (+4 vs Chaos), ignores magic barriers

name: Sigmar's Aegis
description: A gilded shield offering +2 AP and granting allies within 10 yards +1 AP. Boosts courage, but failed Leadership tests may cause doubt.

name: Varn's Fury
description: An ancient Dwarven crown granting +1 Strength, +10% Leadership, and resistance to Fear/Terror. Failures in Willpower tests make the wearer stubborn, imposing penalties to Fellowship.

name: Elderbranch
description: A living Witchwood staff allowing two free spells per day without a channeling test. Harming nature imposes a -10% casting penalty for one day.

stats.effect: 2 free spells/day, -10% casting if nature harmed

name: Ashfeather Amulet
description: An amulet granting +10% Fear/Terror resistance and a one-time resurrection at 1 Wound. Resurrection causes 2 Corruption Points.

name: Umbral Bastion
description: Grants +3 AP (all locations) and can reflect one spell per day (WP test at -10%). Each day worn, pass a WP test or suffer -10% Perception & Fellowship for 24 hours.

name: Mantle of the Inferno
description: A fiery cloak granting immunity to fire damage, imposing -10% WS on enemies in melee, and can release a fire blast once per day. Charm penalties reset after rest.

stats.effect: Immune to fire, -10% WS on enemies
